poi.name: Academy Staging Point
poi.note: Fictional exercise assembly point. No real deployment or access approval.

replay_steps: Open Mapping > Manage POIs. Reuse the exact existing Academy Staging category if present; do not duplicate it.
If absent, use Add POI Type, enter its name, check Is Destination, retain default pin and blue color, then save.
Verify name, color and Destination Yes in the saved list.
Open View > List to check for an existing Academy Staging Point; reuse it if its values match.
If absent, use Add, enter the separate paired coordinates, fictional address and note, then Add POI.
Verify the saved List row and reopen Edit to read back values without changing them.
Return to Mapping, filter for Academy Staging Point, check Show POIs and inspect the marker and popup.
Uncheck Show POIs and observe its marker disappear; recheck and verify it returns.
Restore category visibility and clear the text filter after recording.
